phases.name: Slice 01: Jira reads the parent sources in order
phases.description: Rigor profile thorough. Each step leaves main green. A class-level [Ignore] spanning steps moves onto the methods not yet activated; in Vitest drop .skip and its biome-ignore line. DISCUSS pre-requisites: P1 done, P3 closed, P4 is this order, P2 open and not blocking.
